details: The overall cryptocurrency market experienced a downturn, with Bitcoin falling below $83,000 and the total crypto market capitalization decreasing by 1.25% to approximately $2.8 trillion. This sell-off was accompanied by over $400 million in liquidations within the last 24 hours, following over $600 million in the previous session. Macroeconomic pressures, including rising oil prices, climbing Treasury yields, and reports of possible US military strike options against Iran, are cited as key factors. XRP and Solana also saw losses, while NEAR Protocol bucked the trend with over 3% gains.
title: Bitcoin and Crypto Markets Dip Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Macroeconomic Concerns

details: Ethereum's price slipped below $2,500 on October 8th, reflecting a broader market decline. This move triggered a staggering $759 million in global liquidations over the past 24 hours, with long positions accounting for the majority at $692 million. Bitcoin also experienced a downturn during this period, trading around $81,333.5, and Solana saw declines of over 6%.
title: Ethereum Drops Below $2,500 as Global Liquidations Hit $759 Million

details: The U.S. Treasury Department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) has withdrawn its 2023 proposal to tighten reporting requirements for cryptocurrency mixing transactions. FinCEN cited concerns raised during the rulemaking process that an overly broad definition of mixing could stifle legitimate activity and impose significant reporting burdens on financial institutions. The move also includes the withdrawal of a proposal regarding unhosted wallets.
title: US Treasury Withdraws Proposed Crypto Mixing Rule

details: S&P Global Ratings launched a new Vault Risk Assessment (VRA) framework on October 5, 2026, designed to evaluate the risks associated with crypto lending vaults, a market estimated at $10 billion. The framework assesses six key areas, including portfolio credit quality, liquidity, and governance, aiming to provide transparency on potential investor losses. These assessments are not credit ratings but signify a growing interest from traditional finance in the DeFi sector.
title: S&P Global Introduces Risk Assessments for $10 Billion Crypto Lending Vault Market

details: Payward, the parent company of cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, has integrated Singapore Gulf Bank's (SGB) SGB Net clearing network to enable 24/7 US dollar settlement for select institutional clients in Asia and the Gulf region. This partnership aims to address the limitations of traditional banking hours in the always-on digital asset markets, with plans to expand to more clients and currencies.
title: Kraken Parent Payward Partners with Singapore Gulf Bank for 24/7 Institutional Crypto Settlement

details: Japanese investment company Metaplanet, a significant Bitcoin treasury holder, announced a new net interest income strategy on October 5, 2026. The company plans to allocate 10% to 15% of its total assets to strategic investments that generate recurring income, which will then be used to fund further Bitcoin acquisitions and dividend payments. Bitcoin will remain its core treasury asset, accounting for 85% to 90% of total assets.
sourceName: TradingView (also reported by The Block and Cointelegraph)
title: Metaplanet Unveils Net Interest Income Strategy to Boost Bitcoin Accumulation
